title: health/metadata-application.json
description: Application plane board (Kind metadata). Health Application only. Rewritten every visit, quiet or not. Carries the lookup (probe_job, window, label spellings), last_visit_id (last stamp), last_collected_at (last completed collection), the change-annotation ring, and the board: current[] last-known row per probe, container, host, and scrape target; series[] one estate metric row per visit; visits[]. Not the five-field envelope.

keys.description: Union of every key on current[].

datasource_uid.description: Grafana Prometheus datasource uid when an operator pinned one; null means the tool default.

probe_job.description: Prometheus job label of the blackbox probe targets (scrapeUrl contains /probe?). Discovered from grafana_prometheus_targets or operator-set. Null when no probe job exists; P1-P4 are skipped.

window.description: timerange passed on every query, the avg_over_time range, and the annotations list window. Default 1h. An operator may set it; the nurse does not change it.

latency_threshold_ms.description: Probe duration_ms above this is material and degrades the plane. Default 500. A move of 3x against the board row is also material. An operator may set it; the nurse does not change a value already on the board.

lookup.description: Label spellings seen in the datasource (call L, baseline only). A record, not a filter.

last_visit_id.description: watch_id of the last stamp written. Unchanged on a quiet visit.

last_collected_at.description: checked_at of the last completed collection, stamp or not.

current.description: Last-known row per probe, container, host, and target. A visit replaces every row it measured; containers and hosts it did not see are carried as gone / unreachable.

annotations.description: Grafana annotations inside the window that carry a change:<id> tag, newest first. Replaced every visit call A succeeds.

series.description: One estate row per visit, oldest first.

row.description: Same shape as a stamp reading, without note. Four kinds share the shape; columns that do not apply to a kind are omitted or null. Column sources: references/prometheus.md.

scope.description: probe:<service>@<vantage_point> | container:<host>/<name> | host:<host> | target:<job>/<instance>. Stable key for the board diff.

keys.description: application:<service label> on probe and container rows; device:<device> only when host_name matched inventory/prod.json; site:<site label>; test:probe/<service>@<vantage_point> on probe rows. Never a service: key.

at.description: checked_at of the visit that last measured or carried this row.

state.description: probe: up/down/unknown. container: running/gone. host: up/unreachable. target: up/down/unknown (= health).

service.description: Container rows: the application label text (business name) copied as-is. Not a key.

target.description: Probe rows: instance label (the probed address).

device.description: inventory/prod.json device the host resolved to. Null when unresolved; the nurse does not guess.

time.description: As returned by grafana_annotations (epoch ms or ISO).
